summary: Expanded the direct public-company universe for the restaurant franchisee capex/real-estate node. The cleanest direct exposure found is Four Corners Property Trust, a restaurant-focused triple-net REIT. Essential Properties and Agree Realty provide broader net-lease/sale-leaseback context with restaurant/QSR exposure but less pure exposure. Live Oak Bancshares is a specialty small-business/SBA lender with an explicit franchise-restaurant lending history, making it a plausible financing bottleneck candidate. This pass intentionally avoids restaurant-brand mega caps except as implied demand anchors; the node is more about enabling unit growth, remodels, and franchisee balance-sheet capacity than consumer demand.
